description.value:
Requirement You are wielding two loaded one-handed firearms.

Targets two creatures, each within a different weapon's first range increment

Two targets who both thought they were the one you were looking at.

Make one ranged Strike against each target, one with each firearm. Neither Strike takes the multiple attack penalty from the other, and each target that is hit cannot use reactions until the end of your next turn. Both weapons are emptied.

cinderfall.incomplete: (reaction-denial imposed on the two targets, no companion Effect item exists for this card). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This is a cross-creature effect: it changes a DIFFERENT creature's own roll, HP, condition, healing, or item from the actor's own passive or activated ability, with no companion linked Effect item in this corpus to carry it (unlike the six real *-effect cards this class does have). No selector exists for this anywhere in pf2e-source.
